cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The evening program was a concert by our choir.
cards.example_zh: 晚上的节目是我们合唱团的音乐会。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：纯净的
cards.example_en: The mountain stream looks pure enough to drink.
cards.example_zh: 山里的溪水看起来纯净得可以直接喝。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: I sent a query because my library card was missing.
cards.example_zh: 借书证丢了，我发出了一条查询。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：稀罕的
cards.example_en: Snow is rare in our city, even in January.
cards.example_zh: 即使在一月，我们这座城市也很少下雪。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: She won a prize at the fair for research on local bees.
cards.example_zh: 她对本地蜜蜂的研究在集市上得了奖。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Carrying the camping bag left my shoulder sore.
cards.example_zh: 背了那个露营包，我的肩膀又酸又疼。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: I found a wet sock behind the bathroom door.
cards.example_zh: 我在浴室门后发现了一只湿短袜。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: This free software helps me record my spoken English.
cards.example_zh: 这个免费软件能帮我录下自己说的英语。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: There is hardly any space under my bed for boxes.
cards.example_zh: 我的床底下几乎没有放箱子的空间了。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: A famous film star waved to us outside the cinema.
cards.example_zh: 一位著名的电影明星在电影院外向我们招手。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The sticky honey dripped onto the breakfast table.
cards.example_zh: 黏糊糊的蜂蜜滴到了早餐桌上。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Winter coats stay in storage until the weather turns.
cards.example_zh: 冬天的外套先存放着，等到天气转冷再拿出来。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Ships supply fresh water to the island school each week.
cards.example_zh: 船只每周给岛上的学校补给淡水。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Take one tablet with water after you eat breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 吃完早饭后，用水送服一片药片。
